50848626.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to LSD1 (unknown origin) by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The SPR experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. The LSD1 enzyme (0.5 mg/mL) was immobilized on the chip via amine coupling. The running buffer was 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20, 0.005% Tween-20. Compounds were diluted in running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 nM to 10 μM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. Association and dissociation phases were 180 s and 300 s, respectively. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software, and the binding affinity (KD) was determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
